title: TCS Becomes Official AI and Technology Partner of the Rio Marathon
excerpt: The partnership, announced November 11, is TCS's first marathon sponsorship in Latin America and adds Latin America's largest street race to its 14-event global running portfolio.
body:
• Tata Consultancy Services has become the Official AI and Technology Partner of the Rio Marathon, the company announced on November 11, 2026 — its first marathon sponsorship in Latin America.
  • The Rio Marathon is Latin America's largest street running event and recently earned its first World Athletics Elite Label; its 2026 edition drew about 70,000 runners across four distances.
  • TCS now sponsors 14 running events worldwide, including five of the eight Abbott World Marathon Majors, reaching nearly 700,000 runners a year, according to the company's announcement.
  • The 2027 Rio Marathon will be the race's 25th anniversary edition, and the first run under the TCS partnership.

Tata Consultancy Services has signed on as the Official AI and Technology Partner of the Rio Marathon, the company announced on November 11, 2026, in a release datelined Rio de Janeiro and Mumbai. The partnership is TCS's first marathon sponsorship in Latin America.

The Rio Marathon is the largest street running event in Latin America and one of the fastest-growing races on the global calendar; it recently earned its first World Athletics Elite Label. TCS said it would bring its artificial intelligence, data analytics and digital innovation capabilities to the event, drawing on its work at the TCS London Marathon, the TCS New York City Marathon and the TCS Sydney Marathon presented by ASICS.

The scale of the race — and of TCS's running portfolio

The Rio Marathon registered approximately 70,000 runners across four distances in 2026, with nearly 75% of participants travelling from outside the city, according to reporting by the Hindu BusinessLine. TCS now sponsors 14 running events globally, including five of the eight Abbott World Marathon Majors, engaging nearly 700,000 runners annually. The 2027 Rio Marathon, the first edition under the partnership, will mark the race's 25th anniversary.

"Tata Consultancy Services has signed on as the Official AI and Technology Partner of the Rio Marathon, the company announced on November 11, 2026, in a release datelined Rio de Janeiro and Mumbai."

Why a marathon, for an IT company

Marathon sponsorship is TCS's longest-running brand platform: the races put its name in front of city governments and consumer audiences its enterprise sales teams never reach, and give it a live testbed for the tracking, timing and fan-engagement technology it sells elsewhere. Rio also deepens a commercial footprint, not only a marketing one — TCS has operated in Latin America since 2002 and employs more than 26,000 people across nine countries in the region, including nearly 7,000 in Brazil across São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Londrina, according to the BusinessLine report.

Specific technology deployments for the 2027 race have not yet been detailed; organisers are expected to confirm them in the months before the anniversary edition.
